$comment: Build detail for the K8squad toolchain image factory (ISI-3413). The canonical tool LIST (name + catalog tag) lives in .github/workflows/component-matrix.yml (`toolchains` family); this file carries per-tool build detail (Dockerfile/context + pinned upstream patch buildArgs). The build-images.yml plan leg joins the two and FAILS on drift in either direction. `version` is the CATALOG TAG referenced by config/helm/values.yaml tools.defaultCatalog.entries — it tracks an upstream minor line; `buildArgs` pin the exact upstream patch/release used at build time. Adding a tool = one component-matrix row + one row here + Dockerfile.toolchain-<tool>.

tools.note: ISI-3444: 1.31 line is built with Go < 1.24.13 (stdlib CVE-2025-68121, fixable → gate). v1.36.4 is built on the Go 1.26 line and drops moby/spdystream v0.4.0 for v0.5.1 (CVE-2026-35469).
apk git on alpine 3.21 (2.47 at authoring) — tracks >= 2.45.
ISI-3444: v2.62.0 gated on CVE-2026-48501 (fixed 2.93.0) + grpc CVE-2026-33186 + stdlib CVE-2025-68121. v2.98.0 is built on Go 1.26 with grpc v1.83.0.
ISI-3444: golang:1.23-alpine is EOL and gated on stdlib CVE-2025-68121 / CVE-2025-61726 (fixed in Go 1.24.13 / 1.25.7 / 1.26.x). Track the supported 1.26 line.

ISI-3444: the npm bundled in node:22-alpine ships tar 7.5.11 / brace-expansion 2.0.2 (CRITICAL CVE-2026-59873 / HIGH CVE-2026-13149). The Dockerfile upgrades the bundled npm to NPM_VERSION (12.0.2 declares tar ^7.5.19).
Catalog tag 1.0 tracks the upstream dynatrace-oss/dtctl 0.x line — upstream has not cut a 1.0 release (v0.38.0 latest at authoring). Revisit the catalog tag when upstream ships 1.0.

ISI-3444: v3.16.4 gated on stdlib CVE-2025-68121 (Go 1.22.7), grpc CVE-2026-33186, containerd CVE-2024-25621. v3.21.4 is built on Go 1.26 with grpc v1.82.1 and no containerd dep. Stays on the helm 3.x line (helm 4 is a separate major bump decision).
ISI-3444: the Dockerfile runs `apk upgrade libcrypto3 libssl3` so the openssl fix (libcrypto3 3.5.8-r0, CVE-2026-14456) is deterministic instead of depending on the rolling base ref.

CLI only — no daemon. The daemon stays the existing dockerd sidecar (see values.yaml tools comment). ISI-3444: docker:27-cli (alpine 3.21.3) gated on c-ares CVE-2026-33630 + stdlib/grpc/containerd CVEs in the docker/buildx/compose binaries; docker:29-cli carries the rebuilt binaries on a newer alpine.
apk jq on alpine 3.21 (1.7.1 at authoring).
apk curl on alpine 3.21 (8.x at authoring).
apk make on alpine 3.21 (4.4.x at authoring).
